body:
Hi @ValdoGhafoor,

The cache for `ais-infinite-hits` is separate and we do not provide a way to invalidate it.

However there is a `cache` prop so you can provide your own, you can make a custom cache that can be invalidated like I made here : https://codesandbox.io/s/twilight-voice-d5zuj6?file=/src/App.vue (I wanted to import `isEqual` from `instantsearch.js` but it doesn't seem to work so I copy/pasted it :/ )

You can then call `cache.invalidate` inside `refresh` or whenever you want to.
